sprint.title: Scene Construction V1
sprint.goal: Compose a voluntary North Gate first-contact scene and bounded action refresh using existing safe projections and replaceable local narration.
scope: Read-only scene composition, local narrative adapters, existing opportunity handoff, CLI integration and focused offline verification.
verification: First contact, access and epistemic fidelity, eligibility/cost parity, voluntary participation, causal continuity, no duplicate outcomes, non-mutation, version-1 compatibility, fallback, adapter replacement and affected regressions.
